Requirements for on-site telecommunication smart maintenance management function
bibdata.abstract: Recommendation ITU-T M.3364 introduces requirements for on-site telecommunication smart maintenance management function. In this Recommendation, the requirements for telecommunication smart maintenance function are provided, which include on-site patrol, on-site overhaul, on-site troubleshooting, evaluation of maintenance work, management of maintenance knowledge base, management of service activation function, management of network resource, and management of smart maintenance assistant toolkit (SMAT). This Recommendation also provides use cases of SMAT in telecommunication smart maintenance system (TSMS).
